_help: HOW TO USE: each item in the list below becomes a banner at the top of the app (up to 3 at once). Add more items, separated by commas. Fields: id (unique, give every new message a NEW id), text (the message), type (info = blue, warn = orange, success = green), link (optional web address), button (optional button label, needs a link), expires (optional YYYY-MM-DD, banner disappears after that day). Users can dismiss each banner. Remove an item to take it down. build.bat can also add an 'update-x.y.z' banner by itself.
